name: What should I consider when choosing a sliding glass door for energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: What should I consider when choosing a sliding glass door for energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: When prioritizing energy efficiency, look for sliding glass doors with a low U-factor, which indicates good insulation properties. Doors with a low Solar Heat Gain Coefficient (SHGC) are also important, especially in sunny areas, as they reduce the amount of heat entering your home. Features like double or triple-pane glass, low-emissivity (Low-E) coatings, and argon or krypton gas fills between panes significantly improve thermal performance, helping to maintain indoor temperatures and lower utility bills.
acceptedAnswer.description: For energy efficiency, choose doors with low U-factors and SHGCs, and features like double or triple-pane glass, Low-E coatings, and inert gas fills.
